description.value: Cowdog is a small coffee shop in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on West 4th Avenue, operated under the 'Be Less Shitty Club' brand. It sits on one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors and maintains an online Shopify store alongside its walk-in café service. The shop has a deliberately minimal web presence, directing customers to Instagram and TikTok for updates.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (1927 W 4th Ave, Vancouver BC) and that the business is an active café operating as part of 'Be Less Shitty Club' (per Terms of Service). The Shopify store shows only sold-out seasonal pickup items; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM cuisine=coffee_shop and branch=kits (Kitsilano) are consistent with the website content.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website.
Legal operating entity is 'Be Less Shitty Club' (per Terms of Service), not 'cowdog' — minor name mismatch between brand and registrant.
All products in the online store are currently sold out; store may be dormant or seasonal-only.
Website content is extremely sparse — only address and social media links on the front page — making amenity verification impossible without a site visit.
